digest.component_or_area: plan-review acceptance criteria tagging and verification
propositions: Rename the canonical AC qualifier from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] to accurately reflect that evidence lives outside codebase rather than mischaracterizing who attests
Maintain [operator-attested] as an undocumented backwards-compatible alias for 827 immutable event-sourced tickets already carrying the tag
Widen the deterministic regex matcher to accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively using non-capturing alternation so findall() arity remains unchanged
Widen the .rebar/criteria_routing.json text_all activation trigger to recognize both spellings so project.measurement-provenance fires on [non-codebase]-tagged plans
Sequence reader sites before emitter changes so legacy persisted verdicts with kind='operator-attested' continue rendering identically to new kind='non-codebase' verdicts
Update all author-facing documentation and prompts to emit [non-codebase] only while instructing LLM recognizers that both spellings are accepted
